From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: audit log extract format and snapshot cadence

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear list. Sharing an initial export manifest below and a few clarifying Qs before we produce snapshots:

Quick answers up front:
- We can produce per-event JSONL with a companion manifest (schema + checksums).
- Rolling snapshots: hourly delta files + daily consolidated snapshot (retained 90 days).
- On-demand full snapshot: cold export of the archived partition (TTL-dependent; typically 30–60 min prep).
- Delivery: presigned S3 link preferred for large bundles; SFTP and encrypted HTTP are supported.

Clarifying Qs:
1) Do you need operator identity hashes or original usernames? We can provide salted SHA256 hashes plus a lookup key under an MOU.
2) For PII — are email addresses required for mapping users, or should we redact to <redacted_email>?

Below is the export manifest (summary). I will attach a machine-readable bundle and the signed handoff agreement once we agree scope.

Export manifest (summary):
- format: JSONL (newline-delimited JSON), UTF-8
- filename pattern: redwood-admin-events-YYYYMMDD-HHMM-<shard>.jsonl.gz
- fields: event_id (uuid), event_ts (ISO8601), event_type (enum), actor_id_hash (sha256), actor_role, target_resource, action, client_ip, user_agent, session_id, request_id, kv_cache_delta (nullable), raw_payload_snippet (truncated, 512 chars), region, retention_bucket_id
- ordering: strictly append-ordered per partition; per-file checksum (sha256) + manifest-level signed checksum
- retention metadata: source_partition_start, source_partition_end, event_count, file_size_bytes

Redaction guidance:
- Default: redact email and phone. Provide hashed actor_id values.
- For customers who require de-anonymization during legal requests we can provide a separate lookup under NDA with HSM-backed access logs.

I'll loop in Ben to confirm shard sizing and Kimberly to confirm retention/hold windows.

Best,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Manager, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood_audit_export_manifest_v1.json (application/json)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Asha Menon <asha.menon@crestcorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: audit log extract format and snapshot cadence

Thanks Grace — a couple of operational constraints to note so the manifest is intake-ready:

- Retention windows: live rolling data (hot) retained for 90 days. Cold archive (monthly consolidated snapshots) kept for 2 years by default; we can extend under contract.
- Sampling/partial export: we support timebox slices (e.g., 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z -> 2026-10-07T23:59:59Z) and event-type filters for smaller packages.
- File sizing / sharding: we target 200–500MB gzipped JSONL shards (approx 1–2M events per shard depending on payload).
- Delivery handshake: we require a signed manifest + HMAC of each file. Presigned S3 links have 72h TTL by default; we can increase to 7 days for large transfers with additional approvals.
- Chain-of-custody: every handoff includes a manifest.md5, per-file sha256, and an attestations.txt signed by Redwood signatory.

Attachment: I uploaded a sample shard index for your ingestion team. If you prefer SFTP, provide endpoint and SSH key thumbprint; otherwise send the S3 path where you want bundles placed and we will create a transfer role.

Kimberly Park
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference
